title: Define Android native-extension boundary and errors
description: Why this exists: full CRAN compatibility intersects with compiled native extensions, but the Android-safe Rust runtime should not silently pretend unsupported native entrypoints are available. What needs doing: document and enforce the native-extension policy in dynload/library loading, keep pure-R package behavior working, and return explicit typed errors for unsupported .Call/.C/native libraries.
acceptance_criteria: Native package/library loading has a clear Android policy; unsupported native extension paths fail loudly with typed errors; pure-R package loading is not regressed; release signoff can state the compatibility boundary honestly.
notes: Defined and enforced the Android native-extension boundary at direct R entrypoints. useDynLib() rejection already existed; this now also registers and rejects .Call/.Call.graphics/.C/.Fortran/.External/.External2, dyn.load(), dyn.unload(), and library.dynam() with explicit pure-R Android runtime policy errors instead of silent NULL or host dlopen behavior. Documented the policy in docs/android-security-policy.md and docs/rust-r-port-architecture.md. Added Android embedding test coverage for all direct entrypoints and kept pure-R package/data policy tests green. Validation: cargo fmt --all; cargo fmt --check --all; git diff --check; cargo test -p rmath android::tests::test_native_entrypoints_fail_with_android_policy_errors -- --test-threads=1; cargo test -p rmath android::tests::test_library_rejects_native_code_packages_explicitly -- --test-threads=1; cargo test -p rmath android::tests::test_data_rejects_serialized_package_data_explicitly -- --test-threads=1; cargo test -p rmath mainutils::rdynload:: -- --test-threads=1; cargo test -p rmath eval::builtin:: -- --test-threads=1; scripts/conformance_parity.sh --check --strict --report target/codex-conformance-after-native-policy (225/225); scripts/upstream_core_slices.sh --report target/codex-upstream-after-native-policy (14/14); scripts/pure_r_package_corpus.sh --report target/codex-pure-r-package-after-native-policy (pass).
close_reason: Native extension policy is documented and enforced at package and direct R native entrypoints with green conformance and pure-R package gates.

title: Define and implement the CRAN/native-extension compatibility policy
description: Decide and implement the boundary for packages with native code. Full GNU R/CRAN compatibility normally requires .Call/.C/.Fortran/native shared libraries and R's C API; the project preference is Rust-shaped UniFFI and no C-facing app API. This task must choose a shippable policy: support native packages through a constrained ABI layer, translate/rewrite critical native packages, or declare an Android pure-R product scope. Acceptance: README/docs state the policy plainly; package loader enforces it; conformance/package corpus includes representative native-code package cases or explicit rejection cases.
notes: Closed the CRAN/native-extension compatibility policy as an Android pure-R product boundary. README now states current proof counts (225/225 conformance, 14/14 upstream slices) and explicitly says useDynLib plus direct .Call/.C/.Fortran/.External/dyn.load/library.dynam native entrypoints are rejected until a host-owned native-library policy exists. Enforcement lives in the package loader, dotcode, dynload, and library.dynam paths from rport-rmbf. Validation carried forward from rport-rmbf: cargo fmt --all; cargo fmt --check --all; git diff --check; focused native policy/package tests; conformance 225/225; upstream slices 14/14; pure-R package corpus pass. README-only update additionally passed cargo fmt --check --all and git diff --check.
close_reason: README/docs state the native-code policy, loader/direct native entrypoints enforce it, and native rejection is covered by package and Android tests.

title: Finish methods, S4, primitive dispatch, and compiler/bytecode semantics
description: Close the language-runtime compatibility gaps that matter for real packages: S4 class/method dispatch beyond smoke tests, primitive and group generic dispatch, NextMethod edge cases, replacement functions, promise/condition/source-ref behavior, compiler/bytecode execution and byte-compiled package support. Acceptance: imported upstream methods/compiler tests pass or have precise owned policy gaps; eval remains Rust-shaped with owner-checked SEXP handles and explicit runtime context.
notes:
Closed a concrete methods/substitution gap: methods::do_substitute_direct now mirrors upstream do_substitute_direct.c list/env handling instead of returning input unchanged; base substitute(list/env) now creates a real frame with base parent; substitute_list preserves LANGSXP calls; as.list(c(named=...)) and VectorToPairList preserve names. Added conformance 308_substitute_list_env_preserves_names. Validation: strict conformance 314/314; cargo test -p rmath library::methods::, mainutils::coerce::, mainutils::subassign::; clippy -p rmath -D warnings.

Methods fast-path slice: R_quick_method_check now follows GNU R's direct allMethods selection path instead of always reporting unimplemented. It reads the allMethods slot from the methods-list object, obtains each actual argument's first data class, returns a direct named function method, returns NULL for no match, and descends nested methods-list nodes for multi-argument tables. R_quick_dispatch now follows GNU R's direct table-dispatch path for .AllMTable/.SigLength environments, builds # separated class labels, fills omitted signature arguments as missing, and returns the matching method or NULL. R_selectMethod now covers direct methods-list dispatch: reads the argument slot, resolves an evaluated argument class or a precomputed class string from the dispatch environment, looks up allMethods, and recurses through nested methods-list nodes. R_standardGeneric now covers closure generics with a .Methods methods-list in the generic function environment and executes selected closure methods through R_execMethod. R_dispatchGeneric now covers closure generics initialized for table dispatch via .AllMTable/.SigArgs/.SigLength and executes the matched table method. R_missingArg now follows GNU R's error policy for non-symbol and NULL/non-environment inputs instead of silently returning FALSE, while still detecting values bound to R_MissingArg. methods test utilities R_methods_test_MAKE_CLASS/R_methods_test_NEW now call the real Rust S4 class/object layer. R_externalptr_prototype_object now returns an EXTPTRSXP pointing at R_dummy_extern_place, and the dummy initializer raises the GNU R-style externalptr initializer error. setClass now treats names on the slots=/representation= character vector as S4 slot names, so setClass(A, slots = c(stuff = numeric)); new(A, stuff=...) works like GNU R. Added conformance 310_s4_class_new_slot_basic plus direct-hit, missing-class, table-hit, missing-table-entry, evaluated selectMethod, precomputed-class selectMethod, standardGeneric execution, dispatchGeneric table execution, missingArg, methods utility, and externalptr prototype unit tests. Validation: cargo test -p rmath mainutils::essentials:: -- --test-threads=1; scripts/conformance_parity.sh --check --strict (316/316); cargo clippy -p rmath --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings; git diff --check.
S4 inheritance slice: registered classes now expose inherited slots through s4_all_slots and s4_class_extends. new('Child', parent_slot=..., child_slot=...) validates/fills the transitive child-then-parent slot set; is(child, 'Parent') follows registered S4 containment; slotNames('Child') and slotNames(child_object) return registry order instead of incidental object storage order. Added conformance 311_s4_inherited_slots_basic. Validation: cargo test -p rmath mainutils::essentials:: -- --test-threads=1; cargo test -p rmath mainutils::objects:: -- --test-threads=1; scripts/conformance_parity.sh --check --strict (317/317); cargo clippy -p rmath --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings; git diff --check.
Implementation polish before commit: the S4 slot and inheritance walkers now use a visited HashSet so malformed containment cycles cannot recurse forever; R_extends shares the same s4_class_extends path as is().
S4 callNextMethod slice: R_nextMethodCall now follows GNU R's core methods_list_dispatch.c behavior instead of hard-erroring as unimplemented. It resolves .nextMethod from the method call frame, rewrites matched named actuals to frame-symbol references, evaluates the next method in the call environment, handles internalDispatchMethod by resolving .Generic to the underlying primitive, and suppresses/restores primitive method dispatch around primitive next-method evaluation. Added unit coverage for non-primitive call rewriting and the missing-.nextMethod internal error. Validation: cargo test -p rmath library::methods::methods_list_dispatch:: -- --test-threads=1; cargo test -p rmath mainutils::objects:: -- --test-threads=1; scripts/conformance_parity.sh --check --strict (317/317); cargo clippy -p rmath --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings; git diff --check.
S4 slot-order fidelity: setClass slots=/representation= now preserves GNU R declaration order instead of sorting, contains order is preserved while dropping repeated parents, duplicate slot declarations are rejected, and Android S4 smoke expectations were updated to declaration order. Added conformance 312_s4_slot_order. Validation: cargo test -p rmath mainutils::essentials:: -- --test-threads=1; cargo test -p rmath library::methods::methods_list_dispatch:: -- --test-threads=1; cargo test -p rmath android::tests::test_s4_registry_constructs_slot_objects -- --test-threads=1; scripts/conformance_parity.sh --check --strict (318/318); cargo clippy -p rmath --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings; git diff --check.
Switch special-form slice: routed switch through SPECIALSXP dispatch/registration, fixed do_switch to evaluate EXPR and selected alternatives lazily from the actual pairlist, support character exact matching with missing-alternative fall-through/defaults, numeric alternative selection with empty-alternative errors, and invisible NULL no-match returns. Parser now preserves named missing call arguments as R_MissingArg so switch(a=, ...) reaches runtime semantics. Added conformance 314_switch_special_form. Validation: cargo fmt --check --all; cargo test -p rmath eval::parser -- --test-threads=1; cargo test -p rmath mainutils::builtin -- --test-threads=1; scripts/conformance_parity.sh --check --strict (320/320); cargo clippy -p rmath --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings.

This covers quoted symbols, regular calls, operator calls, and calls containing missing actuals. Added conformance 315_quote_print_language_symbols. Added conformance 317_empty_actual_builtin_errors for list(, 1), sum(1, ), and c(, 1). Implemented GNU R-compatible substitute() argument matching for exact names, partial names, positional fallback, duplicate formal detection, ambiguous partial names, and unused argument diagnostics; added strict conformance coverage.
S4 object fidelity slice: corrected S4 gp-bit handling in duplicate/subassign/deparse helpers, added source-like deparse for registered S4 slot objects, made c() preserve S4 objects as list elements instead of flattening slots, and fixed bind::resolve_promise to only read PRVALUE on PROMSXP. Added strict conformance coverage.
Output/attribute parity slice: atomic vector printing now emits visible non-structural attributes in stock order while skipping structural names/dim/dimnames/class/row.names. This closes print(unclass(...)) gaps for custom attrs and factor levels and preserves regexpr attribute output via the generic path. Added conformance 325_atomic_attribute_printing. title: Replace base/mainutils stubs with Rust-shaped implementations
description: Audit and replace explicit stubs/placeholder behavior in rmath-rs/rmath/src/mainutils and adjacent base runtime modules. High-impact examples found by scan include REPL/main loop/file parsing stubs, memory profiling/finalizer/weakref/externalptr stubs, array/matrix helpers, edit/scan/agrep/color/deparse gaps, match/checkArity warning gaps, and placeholder formatting behavior. notes: do_internal safety slice: .Internal dispatch no longer silently returns NULL for a FunTab entry with no Rust function pointer. It now raises a typed RError naming the unimplemented internal, preserving visibility behavior for implemented internals and making missing ports explicit. Validation: cargo fmt --all --check; cargo clippy -p rmath --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings; scripts/conformance_parity.sh --check --strict (309/309).

title: Bug: %/% tokenized as two tokens (Mod + SlashPercent) instead of one
description: Lexer bug in parser.rs: the integer division operator %/% is broken. When the lexer encounters %, it peeks forward and sees / (not %), so it emits Token::Mod (%%). Then / is consumed, peeks %, emits Token::SlashPercent. Result: a %/% b is lexed as [Mod, SlashPercent] and parsed as a %% / b. Fix: in the '%' branch, check for /% as a 3-character sequence before checking for %%.

title: SEXP free_node can be revisited by GC and double-free payload
description:
Why: memory.rs free_node deallocates payload and pushes node onto free_list, but arena.nodes() still iterates those nodes and later GC passes can revisit/free stale payload state. This risks double-free/use-after-free behavior in GC paths.

What: ensure freed nodes are excluded from GC scans or have their payload/generation/mark state cleared so repeated reclamation is impossible. Add a regression test that frees and then runs repeated GC cycles.

Done: repeated GC cycles do not attempt to reclaim already-freed node payloads; regression test passes.
notes: Implemented in commit 8488b55. RArena::free_node is now idempotent (returns early if pointer already in free_list), and freed nodes are tombstoned: gengc_next_node cleared, attrib cleared, mark cleared, and generation set to Old to avoid repeated young-collection free attempts. Added regression coverage: sexp::memory::tests::test_arena_free_node_idempotent, test_arena_free_vector_clears_payload_pointer, and sexp::gengc::tests::test_minor_gc_does_not_refree_nodes_on_free_list. Validation: cargo test -p rmath sexp::memory::tests::test_arena_free_node_idempotent -- --exact; cargo test -p rmath sexp::memory::tests::test_arena_free_vector_clears_payload_pointer -- --exact; cargo test -p rmath sexp::gengc::tests::test_minor_gc_does_not_refree_nodes_on_free_list -- --exact.
close_reason: Closed

title: SEXP GC compaction treats atomic vectors as SEXP pointers
description:
Why: full GC compaction in gengc.rs currently casts vector payloads to SEXP* for all vector SEXPTYPEs. This is only valid for pointer vectors (VECSXP/EXPRSXP/STRSXP), but is UB for atomic vectors (INTSXP/REALSXP/LGLSXP/CPLXSXP/RAWSXP) and can corrupt memory during reference updates.

What: split compaction/update logic by payload kind and only walk pointer-bearing vectors as SEXP references. Atomic vectors should be copied/compacted as opaque bytes without per-element pointer rewriting. Add regression tests that compact each vector kind.

Done: compaction no longer reinterprets atomic payloads as SEXP pointers; tests cover vector-type-specific compaction behavior and pass.
notes: Implemented in commit 09576fa. GC reference-rewrite phases in sexp/gengc.rs now only walk pointer-bearing vector payloads (STRSXP/VECSXP/EXPRSXP) via vector_payload_has_sexp_refs(), instead of all is_vector_type() payloads. This removes UB reinterpretation of atomic payloads as SEXP*. Added regression tests: test_update_object_references_skips_atomic_vector_payloads (REALSXP payload bit-pattern remains unchanged even when matching a mapped old pointer) and test_update_object_references_updates_pointer_vector_payloads (VECSXP payload is correctly rewritten). Validation: cargo test -p rmath sexp::gengc::tests::test_update_object_references_skips_atomic_vector_payloads -- --exact; cargo test -p rmath sexp::gengc::tests::test_update_object_references_updates_pointer_vector_payloads -- --exact.

value: Android cancellation should use r_embed::CancellationToken at the embedding boundary. Do not enqueue cancellation commands in UniFFI; cancel flips the shared token directly, and eval enqueue resets stale idle cancellation before sending work.

Grid release hooks should stay behind a tiny C shim for now: Rust's pGEDevDesc/pDevDesc are still opaque, so let C dispatch dd->dev->releasePattern/releaseClipPath/releaseMask/releaseGroup and keep Rust callers thin.

Sexp safe atomic accessors should require exact SEXPTYPE tags before reading or writing vector buffers. Do not let integer_elt/as_integer_slice reinterpret REALSXP/LGLSXP/etc.; use logical_elt/iter_logical for LGLSXP output.
